prohibitions: Never expose SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY or provider credentials through NEXT_PUBLIC variables
Never put Production Supabase credentials in a Preview deployment
Never enable a payment control or claim active Web subscription state without a separate approved delivery task

supabase.safeEnvironment: Run hosted Edge URL, CORS, JWT and RLS checks only against an isolated Preview project with disposable data. Do not deploy Production as part of this issue.

edgeFunctions.jwtRule: requireUser calls auth.getUser for bearer tokens before private data access
edgeFunctions.serviceRoleRule: createServiceClient is server-side and requires SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
edgeFunctions.rlsRule: private tables and writes are scoped with auth.uid() = user_id
previewChecks: OPTIONS returns the configured Preview origin and 204
Unauthenticated private POST returns 401 without private data
Authenticated disposable Preview user can access only owned rows
An origin outside WEB_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is not granted as the requested origin

expected: Authenticated users outside the explicit email allow-list remain unauthorized
Every admin API route calls requireAdminUser before data access

subscription.copyRule: Web has no payment controls and does not claim an active subscription

offline.copyRule: Web requires network access for synchronized data and AI features

rollback: Identify the last healthy immutable deployment or release tag
Redeploy the same artifact or create a revert PR for the merge commit
Verify authentication, core consumer routes, logs and data access
Treat database, Edge Function and external provider state as separate rollback surfaces
prohibitions: Do not reset main or force-push a release branch
Do not deploy Production from this task
Do not change the admin allow-list or admin policy as a release shortcut
